lessons: The fix and tests passed: 3420 tests ran and the agent reported every Verification command green. The only finding was bug_evidence. No file exists under tickets/triage-author-invoked-stale-round-guard/evidence/, and chupa/stages.py::_gather_bug fails Check when that directory is empty.

chupa/docs/host-authoring.md (Bug tickets > Evidence) says a kind: bug ticket needs a real evidence file committed with the ticket before it runs. The Scope fence excludes tickets/<stem>/evidence/, so no implement retry can supply it. The ticket must be fixed first.

Before rerunning, commit real evidence of the defect into tickets/triage-author-invoked-stale-round-guard/evidence/, such as captured output showing declined-<id> written for a reopened message whose only author_invoked precedes the reopened intent. Never add a placeholder.

On redo, the approach review found sound in chupa/triage.py::_settle_pass: read checkout.journal.read() once, find the max EFFECT_INTENT index with key retro-recurrence/{message.id}/ and reopened True (default -1), and count only later author_invoked signals for message.id.

On redo, also restate tests/unit/test_triage_author_boundary.py with its 3 named tests, the integration test in tests/integration/test_triage.py, and tests/regress_triage_author_invoked_boundary.py printing only {"regression_result": ...} on stdout, as in tests/regress_drain_deadline.py.
